events.title: Applications are now open for the 2027 UNBC 3MT® competition
events.description: We are excited to announce the upcoming UNBC Graduate Student 3MT® Competition! All UNBC Master’s/PhD. students registered and in good standing in thesis/dissertation-based programs are eligible to participate. Please review the following details carefully to ensure your eligibility and successful application.

events.title: Line Dancing – Monday
events.description: Come and enjoy some line dancing with our energetic and fun loving seniors. You will learn some new patterns every week, or practice the ones you already know and get some great exercise. Great fun is had by all.
